Static application security testing (SAST) is a white-box security technique that analyzes an application's source code to find vulnerabilities, with historical origins in general static program analysis and its adoption for security accelerating in the late 1990s alongside the discussion of threats like SQL injection in new web technologies. It contrasts with dynamic application security testing (DAST), which tests a running application from the outside.
